payload.detail: Release pilot on 92d37ba (10 golden cases, top 10, 96 slots; report retrieval-quality-2026-10-22T08-53-39-443Z) measured 0.9271. Cause: all 89 flagged slots are WA service PDFs that migration 20260926170000 (PR #3111, owner-approved) moved from an import-stamped locally_reviewed to unverified with evidence basis wa_document_control_endorsement. Retrieval order did not change. eval-quality topResultGovernanceCounts counts every unverified slot as review-required whatever its basis. Not the cause: PR #3746 (not in 92d37ba and writes no statuses), and lapsed review dates (review_due is 17 of 96, 0.18, down from 31 of 113 in July). The comparison is also not like for like: July was top 5 over 23 cases, the gate now counts top 10, and the pilot is a 10-case subset. Next action: owner decides between (a) reporting WA-endorsed-not-reviewed-here as its own line and gating on review_due plus unverified with no evidence basis (pilot figure would be 0.18), with a decision record and waiver update, and (b) owner review of the most-surfaced documents: Clozapine (CAMHS), Clozapine Prescribing (AKG), Clozapine Management by GP (NMHS, also review_due), Agitation and Arousal (EMHS, AKG, FSH), Patient Safety Plan (AKG) and Patient Property (AKG) account for 46 of the 89 slots. Recommended: both, with (a) first. No paid run is needed to decide; recompute from the existing pilot JSON.
